Title: LSJ - Imbued and Tension in the Ranks

Messages.Author: Mari.a...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

I am looking for a ruling from LSJ on this situation that came up
during our Pre-Release...

If there is a Tension in the Ranks in play and an imbued goes to the
incapacitated region, does the imbued's controller burn a pool?

Thanks

Mari

Messages.Author: tzimisce_dragon
Messages.Body:
no, but if the imbued was burned then it would burn a pool.

going to torpor has nothing to do with being incapacitated.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
tzimisce_dragon wrote:
> no, but if the imbued was burned then it would burn a pool.
> going to torpor has nothing to do with being incapacitated.

Correct.

(Imbued are under constant tension anyhow -- they don't expect to live
long in the WoD -- so Tension in the Ranks has already been factored in
:-).

Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:
tzimisce_dragon wrote:
> no, but if the imbued was burned then it would burn a pool.
>
> going to torpor has nothing to do with being incapacitated.

Just to clarify, you wouldn't burn a pool if it was burnt while in the
incapacitated region, because Tension only makes you burn pool when a
READY minion is burned.

Same reason you don't burn a pool when a torpored vamp is diablerised.
Card text on Tension. But it's one of those finer points I have noticed
a few playgroups seem to have missed.
